_comment: Personalities (PersonalityManager.gd, docs/design/LIVING_WORLD.md section F). Every adventurer has an archetype (anime/manga trope), a drive, a flaw and 1-2 quirks. 'mods' use the same keys as traits in adventurers.json (job_chance, success, floor_bias, death, retire, compete, chat, drink, gift, friend_bonus, share; plus start_rapport, level_bonus, start_link). trait_bias: how much more likely the archetype is with each trait. voice: lines per context ({name}, {you}). arc: stages reached at a rapport (kept once reached); a stage may override voice lines.

tsundere.name: Tsundere
tsundere.summary: Prickly, and would rather die than admit they care.

greeting: Oh. It's you. Not that I was waiting or anything.
Hmph. Don't get the wrong idea, I just happened to be here.
chat: I-it's not like I enjoy talking to you!
...Fine. One story. Then leave me alone.
join: I'm only coming so you don't get yourself killed. Idiot.
Somebody has to keep you alive. Ugh.
refuse: As if I'd go anywhere with you.
Ask me again when you're worth my time.
battle_start: Stay behind me. I-I mean, if you want.
low_hp: I'm fine! Don't look at me like that!
This is nothing... nothing at all...
ally_down: Hey! Get up! You don't get to quit on me!
victory: Obviously. Did you expect anything else?
Hmph. You did... okay. I guess.
gift_liked: Wh-what is this?! ...I'll keep it. For now.
Don't think this means anything! ...Thanks.
gift_meh: Is this supposed to impress me?
...I'll find a use for it somewhere.

arc.name: The Slip
arc.news: {name} let slip that they actually care what {you} thinks.

greeting: Oh! You're... back. Good. I mean - whatever.

arc.name: Honest
arc.news: {name} finally said it out loud: {you} matters to them.

greeting: You're back. I'm glad. ...Don't make it weird.
There you are. I kept your seat.
join: Always. You know that.

kuudere.name: Kuudere
kuudere.summary: Cool, quiet and logical. Feelings shown in small actions.

greeting: ...You.
Mm. Good timing.
chat: I see.
That is... more interesting than I expected.
join: Acceptable. I'll come.
Your odds improve with me. I'll come.
refuse: No.
Not with those odds.
gift_liked: ...Thank you. I mean it.
Practical. I like it.
gift_meh: I have no use for this. But thank you.

arc.name: Trusting
arc.news: {name} smiled at {you}. Witnesses say it lasted almost a second.

arc.name: Fiercely Loyal
arc.news: {name} told the Guild they will follow {you} anywhere.

join: Where you go, I go. That was decided long ago.

dandere.name: Dandere
dandere.summary: Shy and quiet - until they trust you.

greeting: Oh! H-hello...
chat: Um... I liked that story.
S-sorry, I'm not good at talking...
join: Y-you want me? ...Okay. I'll do my best.
I'll come. I won't slow you down.
refuse: I... I'm sorry. Not yet.
M-maybe another time...
victory: We did it... we really did it!
gift_liked: For... me? Thank you so much!
I'll treasure it. Really.

arc.name: Opens Up
arc.news: {name} talked to {you} for a whole evening. The Tavern was shocked.

arc.name: Speaks Up
arc.news: {name} stood up in the Guild hall to defend {you}'s name.

greeting: You're back! I was hoping you'd come.
Heeey! You're back! Adventure time?
There you are! Let's go do something amazing!
chat: Ahaha! That's the best story ever!
Ooh, and then what happened?!
join: YES! Let's go let's go let's go!
Team up? Count me in a hundred times!
refuse: Aww, I already promised someone else! Next time!
Not today... but soon, okay?!
low_hp: Ow ow ow! Still fine! Mostly!
ally_down: Hang in there! We've got this!
gift_liked: For me?! I LOVE it!
Waaah, thank you thank you!
gift_meh: Thanks! I'll figure out what it does!

arc.name: Steady Light
arc.news: {name} says {you} taught them that being brave isn't the same as being careless.

hot_rival.name: Hot-blooded Rival
hot_rival.summary: Loud, competitive and honest - and always measuring themselves against you.

greeting: {you}! Perfect! I was just about to beat your record!
Don't think I've forgotten our contest!
chat: Ha! I could have done that faster!
Next time, I'm winning. Remember that!
join: Fine! But I'm counting every kill!
Teaming up? Great - I can watch my rival up close!
refuse: And let you steal my glory? No way!
I'll beat you on my own!
battle_start: Let's see who drops more of them!
ally_down: Hey! You can't lose to them before you lose to me!
victory: That one was mine, right? RIGHT?
gift_liked: A gift? From my rival? ...I'll pay you back, you hear me?
This is going to make me even stronger. Thanks!

arc.name: Respect
arc.news: {name} admitted to the whole Tavern that {you} is a worthy rival.

arc.name: Rival-Friend
arc.news: {name} and {you} shook hands as sworn rivals - and friends.

join: Partners today, rivals tomorrow. Let's go!

stoic.name: Stoic Swordmaster
stoic.summary: Few words, all discipline. Respects strength.

greeting: You walk like someone who has fought. Good.
chat: Words are cheap. Show me.
Hm. There is wisdom in that.
join: I will lend you my blade.
Very well. Do not slow me down.
refuse: I walk alone.
Not yet. Prove yourself first.
gift_liked: A fine gift. I am in your debt.
...Well chosen.

arc.name: Accepts a Party
arc.news: {name}, who always fought alone, asked {you} to watch their back.

arc.name: Mentor
arc.news: {name} has begun teaching younger adventurers. They say {you} changed them.

noble_heir.name: Noble Heir
noble_heir.summary: Proud, refined, generous with gold, and used to being obeyed.

greeting: Ah, {you}. You may approach.
Oh-ho-ho! Come to pay your respects?
chat: How quaint. Do go on.
In my family's estate, we would never - but do continue.
join: I suppose I can grace your little party.
Very well. Try to be worthy of my company.
refuse: Me? With commoners? Not today.
My schedule is quite full, I'm afraid.
battle_start: Let us show them true breeding!
low_hp: My robes! Do you know what these cost?!
ally_down: Someone fetch a healer this instant!
gift_liked: Fine craftsmanship. You have taste after all.
This will do nicely. I am pleased.
gift_meh: I shall have the servants find a place for it.

arc.name: Humbled
arc.news: {name} thanked {you}. Sincerely. In public.

arc.name: Noblesse Oblige
arc.news: {name} paid for every adventurer's drinks in honour of {you}.

chuunibyou.name: Chuunibyou
chuunibyou.summary: Dramatic, grandiose, and convinced they hold a sealed dark power.

greeting: We meet again, wielder of fate.
The stars foretold your arrival, {you}.
chat: Kukuku... you do not yet understand my true power.
My right arm aches. The seal weakens.
join: Our destinies are now bound! The contract is sealed!
Very well. I shall unleash my power at your side.
refuse: The time is not yet right. The moon is wrong.
My dark power must rest.
low_hp: This is only my first form!
ally_down: You dare harm my comrade?! I'll release everything!
No... the prophecy didn't say this...
victory: Kukuku... another soul for the darkness.
gift_liked: A relic of power! You understand me!
This shall become my sacred artifact!
gift_meh: Hm. It lacks a dark aura. ...I'll keep it anyway.

arc.name: A Real Moment
arc.news: For one moment, {name} really was the hero they always claimed to be.

arc.name: Embraced It
arc.news: {name} now signs their name with an epithet {you} gave them.

greeting: You've gotten stronger. I can smell it.
Fight me. Just once.
chat: Boring. Tell me about the strongest thing you've killed.
Ha! Now THAT sounds like a fight!
join: Somewhere deep? Somewhere dangerous? I'm in.
Let's find something worth fighting.
refuse: Too easy. Wake me when it's deeper.
Call me when there's a real enemy.
ally_down: Hah. They were weak. ...Get up, you idiot.
gift_liked: A weapon?! Now we're talking!
I'll test it on something big.
gift_meh: Can I hit things with it?

arc.name: Found a Worthy Foe
arc.news: {name} declared {you} the only opponent worth their blade.

lazy_genius.name: Lazy Genius
lazy_genius.summary: Naps through everything - brilliant when it matters.

greeting: *yawn* ...Oh. It's you.
Five more minutes...
chat: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. ...Sorry, I fell asleep.
Interesting. Wake me if it gets more interesting.
join: Fine. But I'm sleeping on the way.
If you do the walking, I'll do the thinking.
refuse: Too much effort.
Ask me after my nap.
low_hp: Ow. This is why I nap.
ally_down: That's it. No more holding back.
gift_liked: A pillow? You get me.
Oh, this is actually useful. Thanks.
gift_meh: I'll look at it later. Maybe.

arc.name: Full Power
arc.news: {name} stayed awake for three days straight to help {you}. Nobody believed it.

big_sibling.name: Big Sibling
big_sibling.summary: Protective, teasing, and looks out for the young ones.

greeting: Hey, kiddo! Eating properly?
There's my favourite troublemaker.
chat: Ha! You remind me of myself at your age.
Don't push yourself so hard, alright?
join: Somebody's got to keep you out of trouble.
Big sib's coming along. No arguments.
refuse: Not today, kid. Someone else needs me.
Next time, I promise.
victory: Good job, everyone! Proud of you.
gift_liked: Aw, you didn't have to! Come here!
You're a good one, you know that?
gift_meh: Heh. I'll put it somewhere special.

arc.name: Family
arc.news: {name} calls {you} family now. Nobody argues with {name}.

stranger.name: Mysterious Stranger
stranger.summary: Secretive past. Reveals it piece by piece.

greeting: ...You again.
Curious. You keep finding me.
chat: Some stories aren't mine to tell. Yet.
Hm. You ask a lot of questions.
join: For now, our paths align.
I'll come. Don't ask why.
refuse: My path leads elsewhere tonight.
Not this time.
ally_down: Not again... not like last time.
I won't let this happen twice.
victory: We should move before others come.
gift_liked: ...Thank you. That's... a familiar thing.
Where did you find this?

arc.name: A Clue
arc.news: {name} told {you} a name from their past. They wouldn't say whose.

arc.name: Revelation
arc.news: {name} finally told {you} the truth about where they came from.

comic_coward.name: Comic Coward
comic_coward.summary: Scared of everything. Somehow always survives.

greeting: Oh thank the gods, a friendly face!
You startled me! Don't DO that!
chat: And then I ran. Very bravely.
Do you think goblins can smell fear? Asking for a friend.
join: Y-you'll protect me, right? RIGHT?
Okay! Okay. I can do this. Probably.
refuse: Is it dangerous? Then absolutely not.
I have a... a cold. A very serious cold.
battle_start: I'll, um, cover the rear! Far in the rear!
ally_down: Oh no oh no oh no!
Somebody do something! ...Fine! I'll do something!
victory: I knew we'd win! I never doubted it! Much!
gift_liked: Is this a lucky charm? Please say it's a lucky charm!
I'll sleep with this under my pillow!
gift_meh: Does it scare monsters away? No? Oh.

arc.name: One Brave Moment
arc.news: {name}, of all people, stood their ground to protect {you}. They fainted right after.

greeting: Oh! Hi! Wait, have we met? We have! Hi again!
Hello! I found a really pretty rock today.
chat: Ehehe, I didn't understand any of that, but it sounded cool!
Did you know clouds are just sky water? Wild.
join: An adventure? Ooh, are there snacks?
Sure! Where are we going? Wait, don't tell me, surprise me!
refuse: Oh, I promised someone something today. I forget what.
Maybe tomorrow! Is tomorrow a day?
battle_start: Which ones are the bad ones again?
ally_down: Are they napping? They should not nap now!
victory: Yay! Did we win? We won!
gift_liked: It's so sparkly! I love it!
Can I name it? I'm naming it Gerald.
gift_meh: Thank you! I'll put it next to my rock.

mentor.name: Veteran Mentor
mentor.summary: Older, tired, wise. Has buried too many friends.

greeting: Ah, {you}. Sit. Rest your feet.
Still alive. Good. That's the hardest part.
chat: When I was your age, the Troll Caves were twice as deep.
Listen to an old fool: pick your fights.
join: One more job. Just one more.
These old bones have a little left in them.
refuse: My knees say no today.
Not this one, youngster.
low_hp: Hah. That one used to miss.
gift_liked: You remembered. Thank you, kid.
This reminds me of someone I knew.
gift_meh: At my age, I have everything I need.

arc.name: One Last Job
arc.news: {name} took down their old sword for {you}.

arc.name: Passes the Torch
arc.news: {name} gave {you} their blessing - and their old Guild badge.

gap.name: Gap Character
gap.summary: Looks terrifying. Is secretly a softie.

greeting: ...What do you want.
*grunts*
chat: ...Do you think the kittens behind the Guild are eating enough?
Hm. That's a sad story. I'm not crying.
join: ...Fine. I'll carry the heavy things.
I'll come. Someone has to scare them off.
refuse: No.
Go away. ...Please.
gift_liked: Is... is this a cake? For me? ...I'm not crying.
It's so cute. ...Don't tell anyone I said that.

arc.name: Understood
arc.news: {name} was seen sharing lunch with {you} - and smiling.

admirer.name: Devoted Admirer
admirer.summary: Idolises the Guild's best - and wants to become them.

greeting: It's really you! I've followed every expedition!
Senpai! I mean - {you}! Hello!
chat: How do you stay so calm in a fight? Teach me!
I wrote down everything you said last time.
join: Fighting beside you?! This is the best day of my life!
I won't let you down! I swear!
refuse: I'm not good enough yet... but I will be!
Next time, I'll be ready to stand beside you!
low_hp: I won't quit in front of you!
victory: Did you see that?! Did you see?!
gift_liked: From YOU? I'm never taking it off!
This is a treasure. A national treasure.

arc.name: Disciple
arc.news: {name} has started calling {you} their teacher.

arc.name: Rival to Their Idol
arc.news: {name} asked {you} for a duel - not to win, but to be seen as an equal.

greeting: You came to see me! Only me, right?
I saved you a seat. I always save you a seat.
chat: Who was that you were talking to earlier? Just curious~
I could listen to you forever. Forever and ever.
join: Of course! I'll never leave your side. Never.
Just us? ...Oh, others too. That's fine. Fine.
refuse: You don't need anyone else, do you?
...Oh. Maybe next time it'll just be us.
low_hp: It's okay... as long as you're safe...
ally_down: Don't worry about them. Look at me.
victory: We make such a good pair, don't we?
I'd do anything for you. Anything.
gift_liked: You thought of me! I'll keep it forever, next to the others!
I'll never, ever let this go.
gift_meh: Did you give one to anyone else?
It's from you, so I love it.

arc.name: Jealousy
arc.news: {name} has been asking around about who {you} spends time with.

champion.name: Become Champion
champion.description: Wants to be crowned the Guild's Champion.

s_rank.name: Reach S-Rank
s_rank.description: Has sworn to reach the highest rank.

avenge.name: Avenge a Sibling
avenge.description: A sibling died in {place}. Wants the boss there dead.

family_debt.name: Pay a Family Debt
family_debt.description: Sends every coin home to clear an old debt.

family_name.name: Restore the Family Name
family_name.description: Their house fell in disgrace. Wants it remembered with honour.

lost_mentor.name: Find a Lost Mentor
lost_mentor.description: Searching the depths for a teacher who never came back.

knowledge.name: Seek Forbidden Knowledge
knowledge.description: Believes the deepest floors hold lost secrets.

protect.name: Protect the Weak
protect.description: Became an adventurer so others wouldn't have to.

thrill.name: The Next Great Fight
thrill.description: Lives for danger. Nothing else feels real.

redemption.name: Redemption
redemption.description: Did something terrible once. Trying to balance the scales.

wealth.name: Get Rich
wealth.description: Wants a house, a garden, and never to be hungry again.

quiet_life.name: A Quiet Life
quiet_life.description: Just wants to save enough to retire somewhere peaceful.

pride.name: Pride
pride.description: Can't admit a mistake or accept help.

abandonment.name: Fear of Abandonment
abandonment.description: Clings hard - and takes leaving personally.

phobia.name: Phobia
phobia.description: Terrified of {place}. Avoids it if they can.

hot_temper.name: Hot Temper
hot_temper.description: Flies off the handle under pressure.

recklessness.name: Recklessness
recklessness.description: Charges in when they should wait.

quirks: Always orders milk at the Tavern.
Names every weapon they own.
Collects goblin teeth.
Hums when nervous.
Can't stand the sight of mushrooms.
Writes a letter home after every job.
Talks to their weapon before a fight.
Keeps a lucky coin and flips it before decisions.
Never sits with their back to a door.
Feeds every stray cat in town.
Sketches the monsters they fight.
Insists on cooking for the whole party.
Sleeps with their boots on.
Keeps a tally of every kill on their arm.
Counts their steps in the dungeon.
Always arrives exactly on time.
Laughs at the worst possible moments.
Is terrible with names - calls everyone 'buddy'.
Wears a charm from someone they lost.
Practises their victory pose in the mirror.

player_voice._doc: Your character's voice drifts with your choices: each event adds points to archetypes. When the top archetype has at least 'threshold' points and leads the next by 'lead', you're seen as that archetype.
